//: Won't step from darkness onto a lit tile (light above LIGHT_AMBIENT_LIT), so it stalks at the edge of your light. Needs the Xbro10 fork build (src/monmove.cpp); in an official build the flag does nothing and BRIGHT_LIGHT fear still drives it off.
With nothing to fight, it flies toward the brightest lit tile it can see, including a carried flashlight. Needs the Xbro10 fork build (src/monmove.cpp); in an official build the flag does nothing.

description: In the dark between the lights there is a grin, too wide and too white, and nothing else you can make out.  It keeps exactly to the edge of your light.  When the light goes out, it doesn't.

death_function.message: The %s fades back into the dark.  The grin goes last.

description: It was a person once, or it learned to look like one.  Now it runs on all fours, head low, listening.  Hounds hunt in small packs and lose their nerve fast when one of them falls.
A moth the size of a dog, dusty grey wings beating in a slow stagger.  Deathmoths gather wherever the lights still work, and they don't care whose light it is.

A survivor who stayed on Level 1 too long.  The skin is gone; raw red muscle stretches over bone, the ribs show through, and pale growths crust the joints.  Yellow eyes burn in a face that is mostly skull.  It shuffles between the pillars on long, thin legs, muttering bay numbers, and rakes at anything that gets close with curved claws of bone.

//: What the Wretch was carrying when they lost themselves: worn clothes and a little of what they scavenged.

name: br_faceling
//: Facelings keep to themselves: everything else leaves them alone and they leave everything alone.

description: Someone in ordinary clothes, walking somewhere without hurrying.  Where the face should be there is only smooth skin: no eyes, no mouth, nothing.  Facelings don't speak and don't seem to want anything from you.  They wander, stop, tilt their heads at sounds, and wander on.  Hurt one and it will fight back.

death_function.message: The %s folds to the floor without a sound.

description: Too tall and too thin, grey and sinewy, leaning forward on long legs.  Over its shoulders hangs a human skin, worn like a coat: the hair is still on it, and the slack face still has its eye holes.  It calls out in that person's voice, asking for help, saying it found water, asking if anyone is there.  It is very good at sounding like someone you'd want to find.

death_function.message: The %s slumps, and the skin it wore slides off it in a heap.

description: A smooth yellow figure with a round head, two black dot eyes and a grin that takes up half its face.  It holds a red balloon on a string.  It is very fast, it is very strong, and it wants you to come to the party.  Nobody who went to the party has said what it was like.

death_function.message: The %s pops like a balloon.  Somewhere, a party horn toots once.

speaker: mon_br_skin_stealer
sound: "Please, I'm hurt.  I can't walk.  Over here."

speaker: mon_br_skin_stealer
sound: "I found water!  There's loads of it, come and look!"

speaker: mon_br_skin_stealer
sound: "Is that you?  It's me.  It's me, I promise."

speaker: mon_br_skin_stealer
sound: "I know the way out.  Follow my voice."
